notes.title: June 2025 Development Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="PlIUpSosM50;full"][/previewyoutube]GAMEPLAY AND MOTION CAPTURE
We’ve recorded multiple new mocap sessions with QB, WR, and DB.


Our focus was to expand on game feel with pocket movement, shotgun formation pre-snap movement, additional short, medium, and deep throws for QBs and better catch in place transitions for the WR.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/5a88862ffa421e73ea7739cdc1e90d157804079b.png"]


TEAM & STADIUM CUSTOMIZATION
As we’ve been working on our community share feature for custom teams, additional time has been placed on jersey customization with stitching color options, stripes, chest logo placement, and more.


Our stadium customization suite, which allows you to set stands, press boxes, scoreboards, tracks, and place objects around the stadium is progressing well.

notes.title: May 2025 Development Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="S21ZxYUELrA;full"][/previewyoutube]TEAM CUSTOMIZATION & SHARING
We have a working prototype for custom team sharing in place that shares team data (branding, players, etc) to a server, lists the team on the server, and allows us to download it in game.



We will begin working on the public UI/menus for this, this summer and look forward to including it in future playtests.


[previewyoutube="gj2zfS4go-Y;full"][/previewyoutube]GAMEPLAY AND MOTION CAPTURE
We’re nearly complete with cleaning up 100+ base locomotion (how players run, turn, etc on the field) animations.


QB can now use lead passing mechanics to throw WRs open while in coverage.


We will be capturing more QB throws and WR catches in June as we work toward a 7on7 game mode playtest later this year.

PLAYTESTER FEEDBACK
First Impressions

“Man, I would say nostalgia... took me back to my time playing in HS.”

“Very good UI. Very easy and simple menu navigation.”



Favorite Part of the Game

“Dynasty mode. I love the feel for it...”

“Training every position in the off-season.”



Gameplay

“Feels like All Pro 2K8... and that"s a plus!”

notes.title: April 2025 Development Update
notes.notes:
TEAM CUSTOMIZATION & SHARING
We have begun implementation on a community share feature for Varsity. This will allow you to share and download custom teams, logos, and slider sets. Our goal is to have this cross platform enabled.

Base logos we ship with the game can be recolored to offer more out-of-the-box options for team customization.


GAMEPLAY AND MOTION CAPTURE
Finally having someone full time dedicated to motion capture and animation clean up is speeding up gameplay development.



Because of this, we’ve been able to focus on gameplay iteration with route running, hand placement for WRs, and ball trajectory from different throw types. You will begin seeing this in action soon.

notes.title: March 2025 Development Update
notes.notes:
MOTION CAPTURE & ANIMATION
Our team has grown! We now have a full time animator on staff. Say hi to Brett, everyone!

He brings with him AAA experience and immediately improves the time from motion capture to clean up to implementation. This means we’ll have gameplay to show you sooner...

DYNASTY: TEAM BRANDING
We've finally take some time to implement a set of new team branding options. Brand presets consist of a logo mascot (Ducks, Raptors, Falcons, etc) and three colors.

You'll eventually be able to "hire" a designer to create/unlock a new brand for your team. Then, like the great client you are, you can change the colors to hot pink and neon green and ruin their hard work.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/d29aba923c450e030fba518f2bc4ec1d6548b786.png"]
DYNASTY: AWARDS & SCHEMES
Players and coaches can now earn annual awards. Not just MVP or Offensive or Defensive player of the year awards, but also...a two-way player of the year award!

Coaching schemes now directly influence game sim results. If your team runs an Air Raid offense, you better have a good QB because you’ll be throwing it. A lot.

notes.title: February Development Update
notes.notes:
Here's what's new:

Dynasty


Players & Stadiums
A few months ago we began showing our new player model and equipment customization in screenshots. Great news, the new player models are in the game!

One question we get asked repeatedly is: will playoffs and championships be played in a pro style stadium? Yes. Absolutely. We’ve officially begun modeling the stadium. More soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/80ddc6387b2908b26d74f6d1256bd6fae96ffef3.jpg

Motion Capture & Animation
Some of you may have seen the mocap session video our DB talent shared in February documenting his experience with behind the scenes footage...

We’ve been capturing new DB motions and an entirely new base locomotion (player movement, turns, running, etc) to increase our quality even more. Oh...and we’re hiring a full time AAA animation specialist too...

[previewyoutube=HCGBYiB17U0;full][/previewyoutube]

Coach Schemes
Each coach now has their own scheme and tendencies. This will factor in to the type of teams you want to build. 

Do you want to keep your current staff but install a new scheme/playbook in the off season and see how it goes? Or hire someone that already specializes in that scheme to play it safer?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/eb506bdc2fcf9283d01ee1292cd3839cc8c90c39.png

Settings & Audio
We’ve begun working with a composer to create a custom Varsity marching band drum line track that will loop in the menus and be used in some of our marketing materials.

Menus now have sound effects, and players can adjust resolution settings for both 16:9 and 16:10 (ultrawide) aspect ratios.

notes.title: January Development Update
notes.notes:
Here's what's new:

Dynasty

Multiple Seasons
You can now play multiple seasons with your selected team. We do not have a hard limit in place for number of total seasons right now.

At the end of the season players will graduate, coach prestige will change, job offers will be available, and underclassmen will increase their ratings and make decisions on their future.

Other Sports Included in Ratings Boosts
The risk of coaching a large school is losing players to other sports in the off season losing out on training and potentially getting injured.

Now, each sport has their own potential ratings boosts to add value to players that choose to play other sports. The boost will depend heavily on the player themselves.

Offseason UI Updates
We’ve implemented the final art direction that was used in the regular season UI, and updated original “prototype” UI elements from the off season experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/e8882d25f52247ca0eebe5b4388f574bf3bfaeab.jpg

Weekly "XP" Recap UI
At the end of each week, we now showcase any financial changes, the current state and national hype levels, state and national fan counts, and more.

Ignore the duplicated foam finger icons; we'll replace them with the appropriate icons later :)

Performance Updates
With multiple seasons in place, we now have to calculate player changes (ratings, decisions to play other sports, graduations, moving districts, etc) at the end of the season for all players. 

This originally took 6+ minutes for your team’s state. Now? About 30 seconds.

Performance Update: 92% faster 🔥

notes.title: November Development Update
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share the latest progress on Dynasty Mode, one of the most anticipated features in Varsity High School Football. 

Here's what's new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/650e32234e637e7f74f07083c06d6e8b4bbd2e80.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/22e49f15bae37bbf4b2e05ae78dec20b5b98981c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217036/bb258e65713614fa715ce3c0e737b4a72715386b.jpg
Updated equipment options for player customization

Gameplay
DB Implementation: We have the first iteration of our DB logic in place for man coverage, reading routes, following cuts, and trying to swat.

Under the hood, DB awareness ratings will play a huge part in the overall feel. You will be able to see and feel the difference of an elite DB. They will lock down their man and force you to change strategies.

[previewyoutube=BtrNVM6qFMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Dynasty Mode

Multiple Seasons: We have begun the important task of allowing players to play multiple seasons. This includes properly managing elements we shared before: graduating players, growth spurts, coaching report cards, job openings and offers, and so much more.
 
This will be featured in an upcoming Patreon playtest in early 2025 (Q1).

Emergent Situations: We’ve designed the emergent situation engine UI that will showcase important decision making opportunities from a parent, staff, player, or booster giving your coach the option to agree, disagree, or influence them. 

Manage the demands of diva WRs, overbearing parents, and unethical boosters. Get ready for drama.

notes.title: September Development Update
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share the latest progress on Dynasty Mode, one of the most anticipated features in Varsity High School Football. 

Here's what's new:

Dynasty Mode
Box Score Stats: One of the most requested features from our playtesters has been the ability to view player and team stats after simulated games. We’re excited to announce that development on this feature is complete! You’ll soon be able to dive into detailed stats after each game .

Team Schedules: The backend work for team and weekly district schedules is now finished. These additions will be implemented into the Dynasty UI next month .

Injury Progress: Player injuries are now more detailed than ever. The new Player Update and Player Detail screens will show exactly how long a player will be out, so you can plan your strategies accordingly. Minor injuries, such as thigh contusions, may allow players to return to the field sooner than expected .

Weekly Awards: We’ve also started work on Weekly Offensive and Defensive Player awards at both the District and Region levels. Keep an eye out for these honors in future updates .

Playtest #4 Feedback
We recently wrapped up our fourth playtest with our Patreon supporters, and the feedback has been amazing! Here's what players are saying:

"The fluidity of movement in the QB mini-game is one of the best bits of movement I've ever experienced in a sports game." 

"This game already feels so much like a high school football game... it really feels different from a pro or college game already." 

"Managing player training amongst players who are available reminds me of when I coached HS football..."

"Customization off the jump, found my little small town in Ohio for my coach and it made it feel so much more immersive"

"Overall, the look of the game, including camera work, player motions, stadium, etc. all looked really impressive and made me feel like I was playing a really polished AAA game."

We’re dedicated to capturing the unique experience of high school football, and it’s awesome to hear that our efforts are paying off!
